purpose: Production candidate for the independently rotating player primary weapon.
facing: right-facing horizontal master with muzzle to the right
lighting: controlled cyan rim light with restrained warm-orange energy emission
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production candidate for an independently rotating 2D Godot primary-weapon sprite master. Use the approved A style-lock reference for bold tactical graphic illustration, clean hard-surface planes, restrained hand-painted cel shading, worn dark composite and oxidized metal. Create one compact sci-fi rifle isolated by itself, horizontal with stock at left and muzzle at right, pivot-friendly centerline, warm-orange energy chamber and muzzle accents, a small cool-cyan rim, chunky readable proportions, no hands and no character. Keep the weapon silhouette clear at a 64x64 bounding box and leave enough empty space around it for rotation. Generate on a perfectly flat solid #00ff00 chroma-key background for local removal; the background must have no gradients, shadows, texture, reflections, floor plane, or lighting variation. Do not use #00ff00 in the weapon. No text, border, watermark, scenery, cast shadow, contact shadow, reflection, loose cable, excessive bloom, or opaque halo.
negative_constraints: no character, hands, arms, or body
no diagonal presentation or perspective mismatch
no acid green in the weapon
no border, scenery, watermark, excessive bloom, or opaque halo
